description: Noiseless oracle *assumptions* for PR #218's strong synthetic peak-shift seed response; only source-independent Hoeffding/Bonferroni design bounds, not estimated field variance or sample requirements.
interpretation: Cell interval halfwidth is K sqrt(log(20/alpha)/(2 B)), with B truly independently randomized patch-stage 10-plant batches and five registered exsertion settings. No outcome censoring; any observed missingness further widens intervals.
